preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case starts with an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of nodes in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(t * (n - 1))]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, each edge being a pair of distinct integers u, v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n) representing the tree's edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= n for x in [int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Hidden nodes are distinct integers in the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all('?' in query and query.startswith('?') and len(query.split()) == 1 + c for query, c in queries)
postconditions.description: Each query starts with '? c' where c is the number of nodes being queried (1 ≤ c ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in nodes) for query, (c, nodes) in zip(queries, parsed_queries))
postconditions.description: Each query contains a valid number of nodes c and each node in the query is within the valid range [1, n].
No more than 14 queries are made per test case.

postconditions.expression: all('!' in answer and answer.startswith('!') and len(answer.split()) == 3 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: The answer is formatted as '! s f' where s and f are the guessed hidden nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= f <= n and s != f for s, f in guessed_nodes)
postconditions.description: The guessed hidden nodes are distinct integers within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(guessed_nodes == hidden_nodes for guessed_nodes, hidden_nodes in zip(guessed_nodes_list, hidden_nodes_list))
postconditions.description: The guessed hidden nodes must exactly match the actual hidden nodes for each test case.
